text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (April 16, 2026) for 299 Forman Avenue

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed Items 1 through 3, 4 (subject to appellant installing appropriate signage) and items 6 to 8 of the Property Standards Order (April 16, 2026), for 299 Forman Avenue, Folder No. 26 143034 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to October 30, 2026. 2. Confirmed the Property Standards Order, Item number 5, dated April 16, 2026, for 299 Forman Avenue, Folder No. 26 143034 PRS 00 IV with an amendment to remove the requirement for brick stain remediation and in doing so granted an extension of time to July 30, 2027.
